media.title: Jerzy Fitelberg — portrait photograph, 1937
media.description: Jerzy Fitelberg, the composer whose Berlin circle Kaper joined after moving there; by Kaper’s own account Fitelberg urged him to study privately rather than at the Hochschule. Portrait photograph in profile, 1937.
